h: Pinchas Transforms His Ancestry Into the Covenant of Peace

p: Have you seen this son of Puti,
שֶׁפִּיטֵּם אֲבִי אִמּוֹ עֲגָלִים לַעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה
whose mother's father fattened calves for idolatry,
and he killed a prince of a tribe of Yisrael!
The verse came and traced his lineage, etc."
why they disparaged him for this,
that his mother was the daughter of Yisro,
who at any rate had converted;
בְּכָל מָקוֹם נִקְרָא יִתְרוֹ בְּשֵׁמוֹת אֲחֵרִים
everywhere is Yisro called by other names,
נִקְרָא יִתְרוֹ בְּשֵׁם פּוּטִיאֵל (שְׁמוֹת ו, כה)
Yisro is called by the name Putiel (Shemos 6:25),
עַל שֵׁם שֶׁפִּיטֵּם עֲגָלִים לַעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה
because he fattened calves for idolatry?
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
according to what is written in the holy Zohar
"The ornaments of the Children of Yisrael
were presents that they took, etc.;
And in the Gemara (Shabbos 88a) they said
that they are the crowns that they merited,
that by taking from Esav his power,
which is "the hands are the hands of Esav,"
זָכוּ עַל יְדֵי זֶה לְכֶתֶר נַעֲשֶׂה
they thereby merited the crown of "naaseh";
and from Yishmael they took his power,
for so he is called Yishmael,
and when they took his power for holiness,
זָכוּ עַל יְדֵי זֶה לְכֶתֶר נִשְׁמָע
they thereby merited the crown of "nishma."
who was at first the priest of Midian:
afterward, when he repented and converted,
through Elazar's taking a wife from his daughters,
he merited that Pinchas was born,
For Aharon merited the kehunah himself;
as is stated in the Gemara (Zevachim 101b):
through Elazar's having taken a wife
And this is along the lines of
and this is what people say:
comes the axe handle that goes into it."
וַיַּךְ אֶת מוֹאָב וְגוֹ׳ (שְׁמוּאֵל ב ח, ב)
this is what people say, etc.";
by coming from the daughters of Putiel,
felt more strongly the need to be zealous over this,
אֲשֶׁר נִכְּלוּ לָכֶם עַל דְּבַר פְּעוֹר (בְּמִדְבַּר כה, יח)
"which they plotted against you in the matter of Peor" (Bamidbar 25:18),
and therefore he afterward merited the kehunah.
because he came from the daughters of Yisro;
and therefore it is mentioned at Elazar's marriage:
"from the daughters of Putiel," who fattened, etc.
Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him, said to him:
"Let the one who reads the letter
since he was more zealous than all of them,
he has a connection to this, to be zealous.
וְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, חֵלֶק ג רכ, א)
And it is stated in the holy Zohar (this parshah, III 220a):
that is, from the light of Torah she'b'al peh,
the aspect of the lower wisdom;
as is written in the holy Zohar
"The upper yud is from Havayah, etc.;
the small yud is from Adnus";
for the letter yud is Chochmah.
And it is written in the sefarim
that Rashi, of blessed memory, alluded to this
is said with reference to thought"
(and "Chochmah is the brain, it is thought,"
the aspect of the Written Torah,
which is the Name of Hashem;
וְיוּד זְעֵירָא הוּא מִן הַשֵּׁם אֲדֹנָי
and the small yud is from the Name Adnus,
And this is because according to the Written Torah
it is not written that he is liable to death,
רַק עַל פִּי תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
only according to the Oral Torah
that is, one in whose heart burns
the zeal of Hashem of Hosts
and so it is fitting for him.
because he was from the daughters of Putiel;
therefore the zeal burned in him more.
And the tribes did not know this,
therefore they attributed it to discredit
there was no need to be zealous,
and only because he came from Yisro,
who was the priest of Midian,
there was anger in him, Heaven forbid,
which is the kelipah of Midian;
that is why he was zealous.
Therefore the verse came and traced his lineage,
that he is the son of Aharon HaKohen,
for the trait of a Kohen is kindness,
"loving people and bringing them close to Torah";
and on the contrary, out of love of Yisrael he was zealous;
with Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
that they said in the Midrash
That is, he acted without calculation
with a few men against such kings,
only because of the zeal that burned in him
over their having opened with the sword,
in order to conquer a land
and through zeal he pursued them;
and this was out of great love of people
and from his trait, which was the trait of kindness.
So too the verse testified about Pinchas
from the trait of kindness and from love of Yisrael,
for he saw that the wrath had gone forth,
and he turned back the wrath;
and through this he merited the kehunah.
וְזֶה שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (שָׁם רכא, ב)
And this is what is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 221b):
"'And the name of the man of Yisrael who was struck,
since the Holy One, blessed is He, raised him
He did not want to mention Pinchas
That is, Hashem Yisbarach made clear
then, "who was struck, who was struck,"
that Pinchas did not kill them of his own accord,
but that such was His will, may He be blessed;
וְלֹא הָיָה מִכַּעַס וְקִנְאָה חַס וְשָׁלוֹם
and it was not from anger and zealotry, Heaven forbid,
הִנְנִי נוֹתֵן לוֹ אֶת בְּרִיתִי שָׁלוֹם
"Behold, I give him My covenant of peace."
And peace is the level of Yosef HaTzaddik,
וַיַּכֵּר יוֹסֵף אֶת אֶחָיו (בְּרֵאשִׁית מב, ח)
when they fell into his hand,
And it is written with a broken vav,
there was still a claim in this,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (מִדְרַשׁ רַבָּה וַיֵּשֶׁב פָּרָשָׁה פז)
"And it went out through his fingernails,
'And the arms of his hands were made supple'";
was complete in the attribute of the covenant
and is called "the angel of the covenant" (Malachi 3:1).
And afterward there is written in this parshah
the count of those who entered the Land;
וַיַּבְדֵּל אֱלֹהִים בֵּין הָאוֹר וּבֵין הַחֹשֶׁךְ (בְּרֵאשִׁית א, ד)
"'And God separated between the light and the darkness' (Bereishis 1:4)
corresponds to the book of Bamidbar,
between those who left Egypt and those who entered the Land."
For the first count in this book
is of those who left Egypt,
and here is the count of those who entered the Land,
which corresponds to the Oral Torah,
which is the level of Yehoshua,
as they said, "and handed it on to Yehoshua,"
which refers to the Oral Torah,
as is written in the holy Zohar
that about Torah she'b'al peh it is written:
וַיִּתְּנָהּ אֶל הַכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי לֵוִי וְגוֹ׳ (דְּבָרִים לא, ט)
"And he gave it to the Kohanim, the sons of Levi, etc." (Devarim 31:9).
וְעַל עַמְלֵי תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה כְּתִיב
And about those who toil in the Oral Torah it is written
the light created on the first day,
which the Holy One, blessed is He, hid away
for those who toil in the Oral Torah
And this is the small yud,
from the small letters of the lower world,
And afterward there is stated in this parshah
the section of the festivals and the Mussaf offerings,
bring holiness into the month and the festivals?
It is through their being holy,
when it is filled from what is holy, becomes holy,
כָּל מָקוֹם שֶׁאַתָּה מוֹצֵא גֶּדֶר עֶרְוָה
"Wherever you find a fence against immorality,
they are able to sanctify the month and festivals.
And Shabbos too is in the secret of the covenant,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (בְּרֵאשִׁית נו, א)
as is written in the holy Zohar (Bereishis, 56a);
and in it there is a revelation
as has been explained several times.
